messages:
priya: heads-up: aurora-40k int8 onboarding hit a weird duplication during long-prefill. at ~65_540 tokens the generator started repeating a 7-token chunk and kv-cache shows two entries for same pos range. anyone free to triage?

maria: can you share the exact seed + cmd? is this on dedi or hosted? which runtime commit?

priya: repro on dedi-longctx-2, runtime 0.21.3-rc2, int8-ext quant. command we ran:```
./longbench --model aurora-40k-int8 --prefill 66000 --batch 1 --rng-seed 1234 --log debug --dump-kv trace_kv.log
```
log snip:```
[INFO] prefill complete: 66012 tokens
[DEBUG] kv_write pos_start=65532 pos_end=65538 shard=0 key=0x7f3a
[DEBUG] kv_write pos_start=65532 pos_end=65538 shard=0 key=0x7f3a
[WARN] generation repeat detected: token_window="the data shows" count=7
[DEBUG] rotary_scale=0.9999998807907104
```

devon: duplication + duplicate kv_write lines suggest either a race in the prefill flush path or RoPE wrap arithmetic overflow on boundary. note the pos values near 65536 (2^16) — could be an unsigned 16-bit wrap in a conversion step. did we recently change any pos->index casts?

priya: good catch. we recently added a short-path in sharded-kv that casts positional offsets into uint16_t for compact indexing on the int8 path. might be the culprit.

maria: can you reproduce with pos cast disabled? set env KV_COMPACT_IDX=0 and rerun the repro.

priya: reran with KV_COMPACT_IDX=0; no duplication in same run. single kv_write per span and no generation repeats. perf looks identical for this case (~+1% latency noisy).

devon: confirms: looks like compact index overflow at >65535. i will open a quick PR to clamp to 32-bit and add asserts. but we should also add a longctx regression test that forces index sizes across several wrappoints: 65534..65540, 131070..131076, etc.

maria: agree. also add a synthetic that exercises RoPE scaling near those boundaries. sometimes small rotary_scale <1 can bias the effective index mapping when combined with compact representation.

priya: created ticket ML-1493: "aurora-40k: compact-kv-index overflow -> token duplication around 64k boundary" with logs and repro. PR coming from devon for fix + unit tests.

bench-bot: canary scheduled: aurora40k-compactidx-fix -> pool:dedi-longctx-2 (24h), aurora40k-auto -> pool:dedi-longctx-2 (24h). diff-runner will compare token streams and KV diffs. results -> /bench/aurora40k/compactidx_ab. ETA 22h. :robot_face:

devops-bot: FYI: denied auto-rollout for aurora-40k-int8 until ML-1493 resolved and canary passes. tagging release-engineering.

devon: quick note for the PR: i'll include a small fuzz that increments prefill lengths randomly around 64k boundaries and checks kv uniqueness with a hashset. also include a CI perf job to ensure compact idx disabled doesn't regress memory too much.

priya: thanks. checklist I've put in the ticket: reproduce log + dump, env toggle test, PR with clamp + asserts, longctx-eval addition (goldset with 70k prefill), canary schedule, block rollout until pass.

maria: perfect. TL;DR: aurora-40k int8 duplication traced to uint16 compact index overflow at ~65536; KV_COMPACT_IDX=0 disables compact path as workaround; PR + longctx test planned; canary scheduled.
